text:
maria: Quick async — who is allowed to flip the emergency disable for the `routing-beta` feature? need to be crystal clear for tonight's canary window. also: what's required for the audit entry?

raj: Only oncall + ENG leads can flip global kill switches per the runbook. for feature-level toggles we allow 'oncall' + the owning eng team lead. so that would be you or @tyler + oncall. runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/feature-flip (see section 'emergency flip auth'). :link: 

tyler: to be explicit — do you want us to hit global or scope to the canary audience? if we scope, it should be `scope=canary` + list the audience id so ops can exclude it quickly.

maria: good point. if it's noisy but not outage-y, scope to canary. if it's causing customer-facing failures then global. for tonight if latency > 300ms for p90 we do global.

raj: also required fields for audit: actor, reason, timestamp, rollout_id, pre/post state, and linked incident/ticket if one exists. please add a 1–2 sentence rationale for the change in the audit entry.

tyler: command I'm planning to run (ok?)
```
# disable for the canary audience only
redwood feature toggle set routing-beta --state=off --scope=canary --audience=CANARY-2026-03-17 --by=@tyler --note="p90 latency spike"
```

maria: thumbs up. add the ticket number in --note too so we can search.

oncall-sre: add PD if user-visible errors > 1%. ops-bot will post an automated audit event but it doesn't substitute for human-written rationale.

ops-bot: Audit event created: action=toggle-off feature=routing-beta actor=@tyler scope=canary audience=CANARY-2026-03-17 rollout_id=rb-20260317-42 ts=2139876589. Link: https://internal.redwood/audit/events/rb-20260317-42 :white_check_mark:

maria: noted. I'll open the incident and paste the ticket in the audit note. tagging @raj for oversight during the flip. once done I'll post the pre/post screenshots and the `redwood logs --filter=routing-beta --since=5m` output.

raj: perfect. one more guardrail — if the flip doesn't reduce errors within 5 minutes, flip back and escalate. add the rollback plan to the ticket (`rollback: re-enable routing-beta and re-route traffic to release v1`).

tyler: copy. I'll execute and post status updates in this thread. :eyes:

maria: thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for handback.
